items.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Java 17 has prompted warnings for server admins, especially as Oracle released 11 new Java SE security updates on the same day. items.title: Oracle to Patch 11 Java Flaws Today as Critical OpenJDK RCE (CVE-2026-114938) Report Emerges
items.description: Oracle is preparing to release security patches for 11 vulnerabilities in Java SE on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, all of which may be exploited remotely without authentication, as separate reports warn of a potentially critical remote code execution (RCE) flaw affecting OpenJDK. The 11 vulnerabilities carry a maximum CVSS 3.1 severity score of 8.1, according to Oracle's advance security notice.
